description: Draw a bullet chart: each measure as a bar against its target marker, e.g. KPIs versus goals. For headline numbers with changes use generate_kpi_card. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

data.description: One row per measure: {category, value, target?, max?}.

name: generate_bullet_chart
title: Bullet chart
